sampling_parameters.sampling_strategy: Mutually Exclusive Priority Stratification (50 pairs per stratum)

lifecycle_definitions.QUEUE_GENERATED: Review queue generated; awaiting human annotator review.
lifecycle_definitions.ANNOTATION_COMPLETED: Full queue reviewed by primary annotator.
lifecycle_definitions.BENCHMARK_FROZEN: Benchmark locked and approved for model evaluation.
lifecycle_definitions.AI_AUTO_ANNOTATED_PILOT: Pilot queue annotated via automated AI suggestion adoption; pending human verification.

known_methodology_constraints: The 500-pair queue is a diagnostic difficulty-stratified sample, NOT a representative estimate of natural candidate prevalence.
Benchmark remains in QUEUE_GENERATED status until human annotator review commences.
Missed-match diagnostic audit (120 records) cannot be extrapolated to a global blocking recall metric without complete universe verification.
notes: Milestone 8: Automated AI adoption of heuristic suggestions for 50-pair pilot queue.
